description: Implementation of NuPlayerStreamListener class handling media stream buffers, commands, and data notifications within Android's media framework.

classes.name: NuPlayerStreamListener
classes.description: Handles streaming buffers, commands, and notifications for media playback in Android.

methods.name: NuPlayerStreamListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer management and setting up the stream source.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts buffer processing by notifying source of available buffers.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a buffer for processing and triggers data notification if needed.

methods.name: issueCommand
methods.description: Issues a command (e.g., EOS, DISCONTINUITY) to the stream source.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data or commands from the buffer queue, handling end-of-stream and discontinuities.
